decisions.statement: A path the world names no page at is refused.
No value taken out is resolved.
A value naming no page is taken out as any other value is.
Taking the value out is left to the mechanical change of the same name.
That change is reached through the runner rather than by an import.
A page left named by no parent is refused by the checks rather than here.
Nothing here works out a body of its own.

definition: one value taken out of one page property, judged by the checks a landing runs
